s: December 13, 2022 - If you're buying one, I'd strongly suggest you get a hide-and-drink leather journal/notebook cover instead. Compatible with a wider range of notebooks, and much more reasonably priced. I've bought tons of their stuff and it's always been absolutely top-notch. Having said that, with some leather and some chicago screws, you can make a refillable binder just as good as the murdy in about half an hour for maybe $15-$20 in supplies, and then you can customize it to whatever dimensions fit your preferred notebook.
